prompt: How many years had passed since the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania was admitted to the Union by the time Rep. Robert D. Heaton was born?
answer: Pennsylvania joined the Union on **December 12, 1787**, and Robert D. Heaton was born on **July 1, 1873**. Thus, **85 years had passed**—more precisely, about **85 years and 6½ months**.
